title: On one screen a route is picked, a run started and stopped, and a route made and changed

steps.check: a new character starts no run by itself, and the race HUD says nothing
the Race window lists the routes on the left, a band behind the one picked
and names that route on the right
over its splits
with Start ready to be pressed
and Stop not, there being no run
under them is the box for a new character's run to start by itself

drawn.text: Start a run when a new character joins its first game

steps.check: what can be done to the routes is in gold under them
a route clicked is the one picked: its name is on the right
and the band is behind it
and the first clicked again is picked again
Start begins a run on the route picked, on its first split
with a clock of its own
Stop can now be pressed
the route is said to have a run going
and the race HUD lists its splits, the first the one the run is on
another route picked while the run goes shows that route, as it stands before a run
and the footer says where the run is

drawn.text: A run on Act bosses (Normal) is being timed

steps.check: going back to the run's route shows the run again
Stop gives the run up, and it is listed under the route's splits
no split is the one a run is on
no route has a run going
and the race HUD has nothing more to say
Edit swaps the screen for the route's own: its name in a box to type over
its splits under it, where the routes were
the routes themselves put away
what is done to a split greyed until one is picked
the splits there are to add on the right, under their difficulty

drawn.text: Add a split at the end

steps.check: and Done where Start and Stop were
a split clicked is picked out, with a band behind it
what is done to it can now be clicked
a split added would go after it
and the footer says what the split is

drawn.text: Duriel: Normal, marked by kill or quest

steps.check: Done goes back to the routes
New makes a route and goes straight to it, its name ready to type over
with no splits yet

drawn.text: Click a split on the right to add it

steps.check: a name typed is the route's
typing over the splits to add narrows them
to the ones that have the text
and the footer counts them
a split clicked is added to the route and picked out
the next would go after it
Remove takes the split picked out of the route
added again and the route done with, it is the route picked
listed with the others
with its split to run
deleting the route is asked for twice, the second time in red
and then it is gone
with the first route picked in its place
with the box ticked, a new character's run starts by itself in its next game
